passed: From a successfully entered source/server directory, go test -c -o <absolute harness> ./internal/api builds the correct API test package. Finally Pop-Location restores cwd.
E2E_SERVER_BINARY and E2E_HARNESS_BINARY assignments are absolute report/bin paths and child Node inherits environment. recovery-server selects E2E_HARNESS_BINARY for overdue harness.
Playwright child WorkingDirectory points at copied source/web; quoted CLI/config argument shape is correct for these paths.

blockers.finding: Continue error policy permits Push-Location failure to continue compilation in caller cwd; Start-Process failure may leave null or previous iteration proc and subsequent waits/logging incorrect.
blockers.fix: Fail closed for directory/process/file operations with Stop; initialize proc per iteration; try/catch/finally persist fixed failure and clean only owned process tree. Native go exit must remain explicitly checked.

blockers.finding: Existing harness accepted solely by path existence, without source/build manifest or hash verification. A stale harness can silently validate another candidate. Server binary likewise not validated here.
blockers.fix: Require reviewed candidate build/handoff hashes and verify both binaries or rebuild explicitly under frozen input manifest; existence is not provenance.

blockers.finding: Startup suite requires three additional role-specific inputs absent from this runner: E2E_STARTUP_HARNESS_BINARY, E2E_STARTUP_CLEANUP_BINARY, E2E_STARTUP_OLD_BINARY. API harness is not their replacement. Uncontrolled inherited values can also point at another source.
blockers.fix: Bind validated cmd/server failure/cleanup test binaries and explicitly approved historical binary; record exact role hashes. Do not silently inherit these env variables.

blockers.finding: WaitForExit is unbounded and no owned-tree cleanup runs on interruption/exception. Per-suite failures or skipped_port_busy do not cause final script exit nonzero, so outer process success can misrepresent acceptance.
blockers.fix: Use declared runner resource deadline with bounded owned-tree termination/wait, preserve interrupted/unknown state, and emit nonzero aggregate exit for any failed/not-run/skipped suite. Keep individual product/test gates unchanged.

additional_notes.finding: playwright.headless.config.ts re-exports playwright.config.ts; both listed suites run same bugs/smoke tests.
additional_notes.impact: Do not sum rows as unique cases; derive suite-qualified test discovery and exact accepted union.

additional_notes.finding: Port probe checks IPv4 loopback only and does not reserve the port; race remains between probe and child binding.
additional_notes.impact: Treat readiness/start errors as failures, not evidence services could safely start; do not kill unrelated listeners.

additional_notes.finding: Several listed lanes are real-media/subtitle lanes; setting audio paths alone does not establish prerequisite model/service authorization or availability.
additional_notes.impact: Keep deterministic mock acceptance and actual audio lanes explicitly separate in final results.

limits: No tests, compilation, service start, file edits to runner, or real-media requests performed.
This review verifies current script text and copied fixture environment contract, not actual built binary content.
